critique: The garden metaphor is beautifully executed at the visceral level with cohesive visual language and delightful plant illustrations, but the behavioral layer undermines the concept's strength — the plants' visual states (flowers, leaves, wilting) don't clearly map to habit performance metrics, creating cognitive friction. While the component craft is meticulous, the spatial relationship between the overview card and the garden visualization feels disconnected, missing an opportunity to reinforce the nurturing narrative through more integrated information architecture.
